{{Quote|I have a medium cruiser in-system that’s carrying a regiment of the finest soldiers this galaxy has ever seen.|Mace Windu, to Nick Rostu|<ref name="Shatterpoint" />}}
A heavy [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] '''regiment''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[clone regimental commander]] [[CRC-09/571]]. The [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] was deployed to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] where it served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during the [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|Battle of Haruun Kal]]. Stationed on the ''[[Halleck]]'', the regiment used twenty [[Jadthu-class landing ship/Legends|''Jadthu''-class landing ships]] to deploy to the surface, during which a third of the regiment was destroyed during the battle. The regiment suffered further casualties on the ground, including the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] CRC-09/571.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />
